【原视频简介】
Today we’re bringing food from our garden straight to the family table! 🌱🥬

I harvested fresh kangkong (water spinach) and other vegetables from our mini garden, then made one of my daughter’s favorite Indonesian foods — Rujak Uleg! 🇮🇩🌶️

Rujak Uleg is a traditional Indonesian vegetable salad made with a freshly ground spicy peanut sauce. It’s sweet, spicy, savory, and full of flavor! 😋

After cooking, we sat down together as a family, enjoyed the food, and shared stories about our day. ❤️ These simple moments are some of my favorite parts of family life in America.

If you’re new here, welcome to Lilik Hayes Family! I share our everyday life in America, Indonesian food and culture, gardening, cooking, family moments, and our journey of building a life between two cultures. 🇮🇩🇺🇸

Thank you so much for watching and spending part of your day with us! ❤️

Don’t forget to LIKE, COMMENT, and SUBSCRIBE if you enjoy family vlogs, Indonesian food, gardening, and simple everyday life in America!
